# Hyperliquid-parity sprint — full findings (2026-10-01)

Generated from all 220 agent results (110 Opus, 110 Fable) of the 2026-10-01 explore sprint on `main` @ `a6917de`.
Every topic was answered independently by one Opus and one Fable agent; both answers are shown.
Synthesis and priorities: [README.md](README.md). Raw structured output: [raw.json](raw.json).

> Agents were read-only and time-boxed. Evidence lines are what each agent reports it read; the
> synthesis marks which claims were re-checked by hand. Treat single-model claims as leads, not facts.

## Round 1 — area explorers (10 areas, ~9 min box)

### order-types

#### order-types — opus

Torus has a working native CLOB order path. It supports Limit and Market orders, the TIFs GTC/IOC/FOK/PostOnly, StopMarket/StopLimit triggers, cancel by order id, cancel-all, modify, per-market tick checks and a minimum lot size, and self-trade prevention that cancels the resting order. Compared with Hyperliquid, the order surface is thin. There are no TP/SL grouping (normalTpsl/positionTpsl), no scale or TWAP orders, no batchModify, no cancel-by-cloid, no expiresAfter, and no slippage cap or price band on market orders. reduce_only is stored but no code path enforces it. The bigger problem is correctness bugs in the lifecycle that exists today. Fills from triggered stop orders are dropped, so the book and positions diverge. ModifyOrder has no ownership check. Modify can leave a crossed book or a zero-quantity order. Pending stop orders cannot be cancelled by id. Stops trigger on last trade price, not mark price.

**Already present:**
- TimeInForce GTC/IOC/FOK/PostOnly (ALO equivalent) in crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1085-1095; PostOnly rejects if it would cross at crates/torus-core/src/order_book.rs:497-505; FOK pre-check at order_book.rs:538-549; IOC/FOK/Market remainder is cancelled at order_book.rs:562-566
- OrderType Limit/Market/StopMarket/StopLimit in crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1072-1083; stops stored in pending_stops with trigger-direction validation at crates/torus-core/src/order_book.rs:420-494
- Tick-size check on limit prices at order_book.rs:396-407; minimum quantity of one lot (dust rejection) at order_book.rs:376-384; positive-price check at order_book.rs:386-394; per-market tick/lot set from market meta at crates/torus-bridge/src/native_executor.rs:2054
- Self-trade prevention (cancels the resting maker order, which is HL's expire-maker behavior) at order_book.rs:1072-1087, with the maker's margin released by the executor (native_executor.rs:5017-5029)
- Cap of 200 resting orders per trader per market at order_book.rs:28 and order_book.rs:409-418
- CancelOrder with an ownership check (native_executor.rs:5162-5206), CancelAllOrders (native_executor.rs:5209+), ModifyOrder that keeps queue priority when only the quantity decreases (order_book.rs:702-776)
- PlaceOrderBatch: many orders under one signature and one nonce (crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:587)
- client_order_id: Option<u64> carried on the Order and returned in RpcOpenOrder (crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1068, crates/torus-rpc/src/types.rs:337)
- Order margin is reserved on resting limit orders and released on fill, cancel and modify (native_executor.rs:4916-5016, 5183-5203, 5368-5417)
- Mempool priority by action category: cancels and non-GTC orders ahead of GTC orders, as on HL (native_executor.rs:6178-6192)
- Ingress rejects unknown market_id (crates/torus-rpc/src/torus.rs:257-270)

| Gap | Status | Impact | Effort | Lockstep |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| reduce_only is stored but never enforced | stub | high | M | yes |

<details><summary>Fills from triggered stop orders are silently dropped (book and positions diverge)</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** A triggered stop or TP order becomes a market or limit order. Its fills settle positions, margin and fees like any other fill and show up in userFills.
- **Torus evidence:** crates/torus-core/src/order_book.rs:1302-1327: trigger_stops calls `let result = self.place_order(params, stop.trader, stop.timestamp);` and only inspects result.status. result.fills and result.self_trade_cancels are discarded. place_order returns only its own `fills` (order_book.rs:552, 576-586). Both executor paths call book.place_order and settle only the returned fills (native_executor.rs:4968, 5040-5085; market_workers.rs:315). check_stops has no non-test callers.
- **Suggestion:** Have trigger_stops collect the PlaceResult of every triggered order: append its fills and self_trade_cancels to the outer PlaceResult, or add a `triggered: Vec<(StopOrder, PlaceResult)>` field. Then make exec_place_order and the market_workers settle path apply_fill, release maker margin and persist trades for those fills. Today, makers hit by a triggered stop lose book quantity without any position change.

</details>

<details><summary>ModifyOrder has no ownership check (anyone can modify any order)</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** modify and batchModify only act on the signer's own orders, identified by oid or cloid.
- **Torus evidence:** crates/torus-bridge/src/native_executor.rs:3250-3254 dispatches `Self::exec_modify_order(ctx, *order_id, *new_price, *new_qty)` without the sender. exec_modify_order (native_executor.rs:5359-5421) never compares order.trader to the sender. Margin deltas are charged to the victim (modified.trader).
- **Suggestion:** Pass `sender` into exec_modify_order and reject when book.get_order(order_id).trader != *sender, the same way exec_cancel_order does at native_executor.rs:5167-5180. Add a test where trader B tries to modify trader A's order.

</details>

<details><summary>Modify does not re-match, validate tick/lot, or roll back on a margin failure</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** HL modify is a cancel-and-replace that goes through full order validation. A new price that crosses is matched (or rejected if ALO), and sizes and prices must respect szDecimals and tick rules.
- **Torus evidence:** order_book.rs:752-775: a price change or qty increase calls cancel_order and then insert_order(replacement). There is no execute_match, no would_cross check and no tick or lot check, so a crossing price leaves a crossed book. new_qty=0 skips the in-place branch (it requires new_q > 0, order_book.rs:726) and inserts an order with remaining_qty 0, which breaks invariant 3 at order_book.rs:940-947. native_executor.rs:5368 mutates the book before the margin check at 5392-5401, and the `insufficient margin` error path returns without reverting the book.
- **Suggestion:** Rewrite OrderBook::modify_order as cancel followed by place_order (keeping priority on a qty-only decrease) so tick, lot, PostOnly and matching all run. Reject new_qty <= 0 or below lot size. In the executor, check the margin delta before mutating the book.

</details>

<details><summary>reduce_only is stored but never enforced</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** A reduce-only order can only shrink the existing position. It is rejected or resized if it would increase or flip the position, and resting reduce-only orders are cancelled or resized when the position shrinks. TP/SL orders are reduce-only by default.
- **Torus evidence:** PlaceOrderParams.reduce_only is defined at crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1067 and copied into Order and StopOrder (order_book.rs:46, 106, 535, 1314). A grep for reduce_only in crates/torus-bridge/src/native_executor.rs finds only a test fixture at :6282, and there are no hits in margin.rs or position.rs, so nothing in matching or settlement reads it.
- **Suggestion:** In exec_place_order (and the batch path), before calling book.place_order, read the trader's position for market_id. Reject a reduce_only order that has no opposite position, and clamp quantity to \|position size\| minus the opposite reduce-only resting quantity. Skip the margin reserve for reduce-only orders. After fills, walk the trader's resting reduce-only orders and cancel or resize them once the position shrinks. Re-check when a stop triggers.

</details>

<details><summary>No TP/SL triggers on mark price and no normalTpsl/positionTpsl grouping</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** Trigger orders have tpsl = tp or sl and isMarket, and fire on the MARK price. Grouping: na; normalTpsl, where child TP/SL orders activate when the parent fills and are sized to it; positionTpsl, where the TP/SL is attached to the whole position and resizes with it. Triggered market orders get a 10% slippage cap.
- **Torus evidence:** OrderType only has StopMarket and StopLimit (crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1072-1083), with no tpsl flag and no grouping field on PlaceOrderParams (lib.rs:1060-1069). Triggers compare against last_trade_price, not mark/oracle (order_book.rs:1272-1289), and trigger direction is validated against last_trade_price (order_book.rs:422-436). Stops are only evaluated after a fill in that same book (order_book.rs:576-579), never on oracle or mark updates.
- **Suggestion:** Add a `tpsl: Tp\|Sl` kind (or Take{trigger} variants) and a `grouping` field to the action, behind an encoding version bump. Evaluate pending triggers against the mark price from torus-core/src/oracle.rs once per block in the executor (after SubmitOraclePrices or the mark update), not on last trade. Store parent-linked children and activate them when the parent fills. For positionTpsl, store a position-attached trigger that is sized at fire time. Default triggered orders to reduce_only.

</details>

<details><summary>Pending stop orders cannot be cancelled or modified individually and do not count toward the order cap</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** Trigger orders have oids and appear in openOrders/frontendOpenOrders. They can be cancelled by oid or cloid and modified.
- **Torus evidence:** cancel_order and get_order look only in order_index, the resting book (order_book.rs:590-594, 816-817). Stops live only in pending_stops (order_book.rs:251, 438, 474), which only cancel_all clears (order_book.rs:651, 695). exec_cancel_order therefore returns 'not found' for a stop id (native_executor.rs:5205). The MAX_ORDERS_PER_TRADER_PER_MARKET check counts trader_orders only (order_book.rs:410), so a trader can queue unlimited stops. Stops place no margin reserve, since reserve_for_qty returns ZERO when price <= 0 (native_executor.rs:4810).
- **Suggestion:** In OrderBook::cancel_order, fall back to removing the id from pending_stops (keeping it id-ascending) and return a synthetic Order. Make get_order or a new get_stop serve the ownership check. Count pending stops in the per-trader cap. Expose stops in getOpenOrders with a trigger flag.

</details>

<details><summary>No cancel-by-cloid; cloid is u64, not 16 bytes, and not unique-indexed</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** cloid is a 128-bit hex value. cancelByCloid and modify-by-cloid are supported, orderStatus can be queried by cloid, and cloid must be unique among the user's open orders.
- **Torus evidence:** client_order_id: Option<u64> (crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1068). NativeAction has only CancelOrder{order_id}, CancelAllOrders and ModifyOrder{order_id} (lib.rs:588-598). There is no cloid index in OrderBook (order_book.rs:240-260), and RPC returns cloid as a string only in RpcOpenOrder (crates/torus-rpc/src/types.rs:337).
- **Suggestion:** Add a HashMap<(Address, u128), OrderId> cloid index to OrderBook, maintained in insert, cancel and match. Add CancelByCloid{market_id, cloid} and a cloid variant of ModifyOrder, and reject a duplicate live cloid at placement. Widening to u128 changes the canonical encoding at lib.rs:711-ish, so version the action encoding.

</details>

<details><summary>No scale or TWAP orders</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** Scale orders spread N limit orders across a price range (built client-side as a batch). TWAP is a native action (twapOrder/twapCancel) that the chain slices every 30s, with a max 3% slippage per slice and catch-up logic.
- **Torus evidence:** The NativeAction enum (crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:580-680) has no Twap variant, and the OrderType enum (lib.rs:1072-1083) has nothing beyond stops. The HL reference table is in research/hyperliquid-deep-dive.md:326-335.
- **Suggestion:** Scale: client-side is enough, since PlaceOrderBatch exists; optionally add an SDK helper. TWAP: add TwapOrder{market_id,is_buy,qty,minutes,reduce_only,randomize} and TwapCancel, persist TWAP state in a CF, and have a block-time hook in the executor emit an IOC slice each 30s of block time, capped at 3% from mark.

</details>

<details><summary>Market orders have no slippage bound or price band</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** HL market orders are IOC limit orders with a slippage price (frontend default 8%, triggered TP/SL 10%). The chain also rejects orders priced too far from the oracle or mark (price bands).
- **Torus evidence:** execute_match ignores price when is_market (order_book.rs:973-976 and 1005-1008), so a market order sweeps the whole opposite side at any price. Market orders also reserve zero margin (native_executor.rs:4916-4921).
- **Suggestion:** Require market orders to carry a worst-price limit, or derive one from mark ± max_slippage_bps in MarketParams, and stop at that price in execute_match. Separately, reject limit orders priced more than X% from the oracle price in exec_place_order (a price band).

</details>

<details><summary>No expiresAfter, and no batchModify / mixed batch cancel</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** Actions carry an optional expiresAfter timestamp and the chain rejects them after it (on HL, a late-expired action also costs extra rate limit). batchModify modifies many orders atomically under one signature. Cancel accepts a list of {a, o}.
- **Torus evidence:** No expiry field on actions: grepping expires/valid_until in crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs and eip712.rs finds only consensus deadline docs, and the only expiry is for sessions (native_executor.rs:5595-5611). There is no batched modify or cancel variant in NativeAction (lib.rs:580-598). Batching exists only for placement (PlaceOrderBatch, lib.rs:587). An internal cancel_batch.rs exists, but no action is wired to it.
- **Suggestion:** Add an optional expires_after_ms to the signed envelope, checked against block timestamp in the executor and the mempool. Add CancelOrderBatch(Vec<OrderId\|Cloid>) routed through the existing order_book/cancel_batch.rs path, and ModifyOrderBatch(Vec<..>) under one nonce.

</details>

<details><summary>Quantity not checked against the lot multiple; market-order and stop prices not tick-checked; fallback books use tick=lot=1</summary>

- **Hyperliquid:** Size must be a multiple of 10^-szDecimals and price is limited to 5 significant figures and max decimals. There is a $10 minimum order notional.
- **Torus evidence:** order_book.rs:377 rejects only quantity < lot_size and never checks quantity % lot_size. The tick check covers OrderType::Limit only (order_book.rs:397), so stop trigger and limit prices are unchecked. There is no minimum notional anywhere: grep min_notional finds nothing in torus-core or torus-types. When no book is loaded, the executor creates one with OrderBook::new(market_id, FixedPoint::ONE, FixedPoint::ONE) (native_executor.rs:3828, 4964), ignoring market meta.
- **Suggestion:** Add a `quantity.raw() % lot_size.raw() != 0` reject. Tick-check StopLimit limit and trigger prices. Add min_notional to MarketParams/MarketListing and check price*qty (mark price for market orders). Replace the ONE/ONE fallback with a lookup of CF_NATIVE_MARKETS meta, or reject when the market is unknown at execution time, not just at RPC ingress.

</details>

*Confidence notes:* Everything was read from code on main at 2026-10-01; nothing was built or tested. Verified directly: the dropped trigger fills (trigger_stops discards place_order results, and place_order returns only its own fills), modify missing the sender, the zero-qty and crossing modify paths, stops being uncancellable by id, and reduce_only being unread outside the type definitions. I did not trace whether some later batch-level reconciliation (for example execute_batch Phase 4 near native_executor.rs:3753-4130) diffs book state against positions and might hide the dropped-fill issue. I believe not, because market_workers.rs:315 also uses only place_result.fills, but I did not read that path fully. I did not check whether the per-action state-overlay rollback reverts the in-memory OrderBook on an err result (that bears on the modify-margin-failure claim). HL facts I am less sure of: the exact default market-order slippage (8% frontend vs a protocol cap), whether HL's STP is strictly expire-maker in every case, the exact price-band thresholds, and the TWAP per-slice cap (3%, per research/hyperliquid-deep-dive.md:333). From the prior audit's claims I confirmed only reduce_only not enforced, no cancel-by-cloid, TP/scale/TWAP absent, and market orders reserving zero margin. The other audit items are outside this area and were not re-verified.

#### order-types — fable

Torus has a solid core limit-order lifecycle: GTC/IOC/FOK/PostOnly(ALO) TIFs, market orders, tick/lot validation, per-trader order caps, self-trade prevention (cancel-resting-maker), cancel/cancel-all/modify (qty-decrease keeps priority), a signed PlaceOrderBatch, and client_order_id carried end-to-end into RPC getOpenOrders. Versus Hyperliquid the gaps are concentrated in trigger orders and risk modifiers: stop orders trigger off last-trade price (not mark/oracle), fills produced by a triggered stop are silently dropped inside OrderBook::trigger_stops and never settled by the executor, pending stops cannot be cancelled individually, reduce_only is carried but never enforced anywhere in the executor, market/stop-market orders reserve zero margin, and exec_modify_order has no sender-ownership check (any signer can modify anyone's resting order). TP (take-profit) orders, positionTpsl grouping, scale, TWAP, cancel-by-cloid, batchModify, expiresAfter/dead-man switch and min-notional are absent. Trading fees are still never charged (total_native_fees only initialised to 0 and read at epoch end).

**Already present:**
- TIF enum GTC/IOC/FOK/PostOnly and OrderType Limit/Market/StopMarket/StopLimit: crates/torus-types/src/lib.rs:1059-1094; wire-encoded in append_canonical_bytes lib.rs:709 and eip712.rs:264
- PostOnly (ALO) reject-on-cross: crates/torus-core/src/order_book.rs:497-505; FOK pre-check can_fill_completely: order_book.rs:541-549; IOC/Market remainder cancelled: order_book.rs:561-567
- Market order rejects on empty opposite book: order_book.rs:509-523
- Lot-size (dust) rejection and tick-size enforcement for limits, positive-price check: order_book.rs:376-407; tick_size/lot_size are per-book fields order_book.rs:252-253,329
- Per-trader-per-market order cap (200): order_book.rs:28,409-418
- Self-trade prevention (cancel resting maker, hand back whole order so executor releases its order-margin): order_book.rs:1078-1091, PlaceResult.self_trade_cancels order_book.rs:68-73
- Cancel by order id with sender-ownership check in executor: native_executor.rs exec_cancel_order (~line 3244 dispatch; ownership check inside fn); cancel_all incl. pending stops: order_book.rs:641-697
- Modify (cancel-and-replace; qty-decrease keeps time priority) with order-margin delta adjust: order_book.rs:699-720, native_executor.rs exec_modify_order (FIX 2 ECON-FIND-05)
- PlaceOrderBatch (one signature/nonce, many orders) with deterministic size cap: torus-types/src/lib.rs:583-587, native_executor.rs:3222-3243
- client_order_id (u64) stored on Order and StopOrder and exposed in RPC getOpenOrders as hex: order_book.rs:47,107; torus-rpc/src/types.rs:337; torus-rpc/src/torus.rs:1916
- Stop trigger-direction validation (buy trigger must be above last trade, sell below): order_book.rs:421-436,457-472
- Order-margin reservation for limit orders at notional/effective_max_leverage with telescoping release on fills/cancels (A5): native_executor.rs:3753-3781, 4781-4817

| exec_modify_order has no sender ownership check | buggy | critical | S | yes |
